metadata.name: syndicate_program
metadata.description: Syndicate Solana/Anchor on-chain program: vault custody, deposits/claims/refunds, fees, and v1 backend-trusted settlement with conservation + signed-price checks.

instructions.name: begin_live
docs: Advance Sealing → Live (plan_v2 §1/§3/§5). Operator-gated. Requires the seal
deadline reached. Drops + penalizes non-sealers (penalty → `dead_money`, entry
fee → `forfeited_fees`); if fewer than `min_players` sealed, VOIDs with the
penalty pool split among sealers. Otherwise re-indexes sealers into contiguous
engine seats, derives the dealer button from the committed drand round's
randomness, and stamps `live_start_ts` + `scheduled_end_ts`.
All seat accounts (exactly `player_count`) are passed as `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pull-based, idempotent claim of a settled seat's payout.

instructions.name: create_and_deposit
docs: Atomic create + seat the creator in a single instruction (plan_v2 §3 convenience).
Equivalent to `[create_match, deposit]` in one tx — same shared logic — but a single
instruction guarantees atomicity regardless of how a client assembles the tx. The
creator (`authority`) is both the payer and the first depositor.

instructions.name: create_match
docs: Create a match. **Permissionless** (plan_v2 §3): any signer may create; the
signer becomes `m.authority` but that grants NO lifecycle power — `lock`/
`begin_live`/`submit_settlement` remain gated to operator ROLE keys, so the
operator monopoly on progression is preserved automatically. Clients submit
`[create_match, deposit]` in one transaction so the creator is seated atomically.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit buy-in + entry fee → seat eligibility (the anti-spam gate, `05 §4`).

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Initialize the global protocol role registry and pause flags.

instructions.name: lock
docs: Lock the match: enough players present → seats frozen, status → Sealing. Records
`lock_ts` and derives `seal_deadline_ts`. The dealer button uses backend-native
randomness submitted at `begin_live` (plan_v2 §3), so no drand round is committed
here. Operator-gated.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Pull-based, idempotent refund on VOID. The amount depends on `void_kind`
(plan_v2 §5): pre-LIVE voids fully refund (deposit + entry fee); an UnderMinSealed
void refunds sealers in full plus their pro-rata share of the non-sealer penalty
pool, while non-sealers get `deposit - penalty` (entry fee forfeited).

instructions.name: set_pauses
docs: Pause/unpause new exposure or settlement submission. Claims/refunds remain live.

instructions.name: set_price_signer
docs: Rotate the Ethereum/secp256k1 address trusted for signed settlement prices.

instructions.name: submit_settlement
docs: Submit the final settlement (v1: backend-trusted payouts).
Verifies the signed price at exactly `scheduled_end_ts`, writes per-seat payouts
supplied by the backend, and enforces conservation. Does NOT replay action logs.
TODO(v1+): restore on-chain action-log replay + `verify_settlement` — see crate header.
Pass the sealed seats as `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: void
docs: Operator emergency void (oracle/timelock fault, incident). Status → Void with
`Emergency` kind: full refund to all, penalties waived (plan_v2 §5).

instructions.name: void_before_start
docs: Permissionless void of an abandoned pre-LIVE match (plan_v2 §3) — no operator
needed, so funds can never strand. Filling past `fill_deadline_ts`, or Sealing
past `seal_deadline_ts + SEAL_VOID_GRACE_SEC` (operator failed to begin_live).
Either way no game ran, so it is a full refund (no penalty).

instructions.name: void_live_after_deadline
docs: Permissionless void of a stuck LIVE match (plan_v2 §H capital-safety backstop).
Reads ONLY the `MatchAccount` — it does NOT depend on the `ActionLog`, which under
the batch-at-settlement model may not exist yet between `begin_live` and
settlement. Anyone may call once `now >= scheduled_end_ts + SETTLE_VOID_GRACE_SEC`,
guaranteeing funds can never strand if the operator vanishes after the match goes
live. Settlement was never recorded, so this is a full refund to all (penalties
waived): `VoidKind::Emergency`.

instructions.name: withdraw_fees
docs: Withdraw fees to the protocol treasury. Settled → all entry fees + rake
(`total_fees`). UnderMinSealed void → only the forfeited non-sealer entry fees
(plus the whole penalty pool if zero sealers remained to receive it). Other void
kinds waive all fees (nothing to withdraw). Idempotent via `fees_withdrawn`.

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: Action not allowed in the current match status.

errors.name: MatchFull
errors.msg: Match is full.

errors.name: NotEnoughPlayers
errors.msg: Not enough players to start.

errors.name: SettlementMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement re-verification failed; funds will NOT be released (04 §18).

errors.name: ConservationViolation
errors.msg: Conservation check failed: payouts + fees != deposits.

errors.name: InvalidSettlementInput
errors.msg: Oracle/settlement inputs invalid or insufficient.

errors.name: InvalidOracleProof
errors.msg: Signed price proof is missing, unauthenticated, or not from the whitelisted signer.

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: Seat already claimed.

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized.

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Protocol action is paused.

errors.name: InvalidSeat
errors.msg: Seat index is invalid or duplicated.

errors.name: SeatSetMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement did not include exactly the occupied seats.

errors.name: InvalidActionInput
errors.msg: Invalid signed action input.

errors.name: InvalidActionLog
errors.msg: Action log is invalid or not initialized.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.msg: Ed25519 signature verification failed.

errors.name: NotYourTurn
errors.msg: Not this player's turn.

errors.name: ActionLogNotFinalized
errors.msg: Action log is not finalized.

errors.name: EngineNotComplete
errors.msg: Engine replay is not complete.

errors.name: PredictionCommitmentMismatch
errors.msg: Prediction reveal does not match signed commitment.

errors.name: SettlementDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Settlement deadline passed; use void/refund path.

errors.name: FeesAlreadyWithdrawn
errors.msg: Match fees were already withdrawn.

errors.name: ButtonNotSet
errors.msg: Dealer button has not been recorded.

errors.name: SealWindowClosed
errors.msg: Seal window has closed; commitment rejected (after seal_deadline_ts).

errors.name: SealDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Seal deadline has not been reached; cannot begin live yet.

errors.name: FillDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Fill deadline has not been reached; cannot permissionlessly void yet.

errors.name: SettleGraceNotElapsed
errors.msg: Settlement grace has not elapsed; cannot permissionlessly void the live match yet.

errors.name: BeginLiveWindowPassed
errors.msg: begin_live window elapsed; the operator did not start the match in time (void only).

errors.name: AlreadySealed
errors.msg: Seat has already recorded a seal commitment.

errors.name: InvalidDrandRound
errors.msg: drand button round is invalid (must publish after the seal deadline).

errors.name: InvalidButtonRandomness
errors.msg: drand button randomness is missing or does not match the committed round.

errors.name: OracleToleranceTooWide
errors.msg: Oracle tolerance window is too wide; must be tight (single-update).

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Invalid match configuration parameter.

errors.name: RefundUnavailable
errors.msg: Refund not available for this seat in the current void kind.

fields.name: button_randomness
docs: Backend-native CSPRNG randomness (server-attested, plan_v2 §3) used to derive the
dealer button over the sealed seats. Recorded for audit; not on-chain verified —
the button only sets blind/action order, so this is a deliberate low-risk choice.

fields.name: price_token
docs: 20-byte token/feed identifier signed by the signed-price-server.

fields.name: total_betting_duration_sec
docs: Total wall-clock betting span (Σ street durations + observation), bound in config.
`scheduled_end_ts` is derived on-chain at begin_live (= live_start + this).

fields.name: begin_live_window_sec
docs: Max delay after seal deadline for the operator to call begin_live (0 → default 5s).

types.name: MatchAccount
docs: One match. Holds the fee config, the bound-config hash (replay anchor), on-chain
timing (`lock_ts`/`seal_deadline_ts`/`live_start_ts`/`scheduled_end_ts`), the drand
button commitment, the non-sealer penalty pool, and running totals. Custody of funds
lives in the associated `vault` token account PDA.

fields.name: price_token
docs: 20-byte token/feed identifier signed by the signed-price-server.

fields.name: fill_deadline_ts
docs: Fill deadline; after this, permissionless `void_before_start` if still Filling.

fields.name: lock_ts
docs: Set at `lock`: Clock::now when Filling -> Sealing.

fields.name: seal_deadline_ts
docs: `lock_ts + seal_window_sec`; seals must be recorded at or before this.

fields.name: live_start_ts
docs: Set at `begin_live`: Clock::now when Sealing -> Live.

fields.name: scheduled_end_ts
docs: `live_start_ts + total_betting_duration_sec`; oracle window anchor.

fields.name: total_betting_duration_sec
docs: Bound at create: total wall-clock betting span (Σ street durations + observation).

fields.name: seal_window_sec
docs: Bound at create: SEALING window length.

fields.name: begin_live_window_sec
docs: Bound at create: max delay after `seal_deadline_ts` within which the operator must
call `begin_live` (default 5s). Keeps `scheduled_end_ts` tightly pinned to the seal
round so a timelock target can't be decrypted mid-match (plan_v2 §I hardening).

fields.name: signed_price_hash
docs: EIP-191 hash of the signed server price accepted at settlement.

fields.name: signed_price_timestamp_ms
docs: Signed server timestamp accepted at settlement, in Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: nonseal_penalty_bps
docs: Non-sealer penalty in basis points of `buy_in` (plan_v2 §5). Bound in config_hash.

fields.name: sealed_count
docs: Seats that recorded a seal commitment by `seal_deadline_ts` (set at begin_live).

fields.name: next_seal_seq
docs: Monotonic seal-order counter assigned on-chain (arrival order) so a player cannot
claim `seal_seq = 0` to grab tie-remainders. Each commitment takes the current
value, then increments.

fields.name: forfeited_fees
docs: Non-sealer entry fees forfeited to treasury (withdrawable post-terminal).

fields.name: dead_money
docs: Non-sealer penalty pool: Live -> injected into the main pot at settlement;
UnderMinSealed void -> split pro-rata among sealers (plan_v2 §4/§5).

fields.name: button_randomness
docs: Operator-supplied CSPRNG randomness recorded at `begin_live` for audit. Backend-
native (NOT drand): the dealer button only sets blind/action order, so this is a
deliberately low-stakes, server-attested value rather than a verified beacon.

fields.name: button
docs: Dealer button seat index (engine index), derived from `button_randomness`.

types.name: ProtocolState
docs: Global protocol controls and role registry.

fields.name: price_signer
docs: Ethereum/secp256k1 address allowed to attest settlement prices.

fields.name: commitment
docs: Hash of the time-lock ciphertext (the prediction commitment).

fields.name: timelock_target
docs: drand round the prediction is time-lock encrypted to (must publish after match end).

types.name: SeatAccount
docs: One player's seat in a match. The seal commitment is recorded here DURING Sealing
(before LIVE), gated by `seal_deadline_ts` — the §207 fix. `payout` is written at
verified settlement; `refund` pays per `MatchAccount::void_kind`. Pull-based,
idempotent via `claimed`.

fields.name: prediction_commitment
docs: Hash of the time-lock ciphertext (prediction commitment).

fields.name: timelock_target
docs: drand round the prediction is time-lock encrypted to (match end).

fields.name: seal_seq
docs: Deterministic seal order (earlier seal => smaller). Tiebreak for remainders.

fields.name: commitment_set
docs: True once a valid commitment was recorded at or before `seal_deadline_ts`.

fields.name: is_non_sealer
docs: True if this seat had the seal window but did not commit (dropped + penalized).

fields.name: penalty
docs: Penalty forfeited to the pot/sealers if `is_non_sealer` (= buy_in * penalty_bps).

fields.name: engine_seat
docs: Contiguous engine seat index assigned to a sealer at begin_live; `NO_ENGINE_SEAT`
for dropped non-sealers. The engine + settlement index by this, not `seat_index`.

fields.name: gets_remainder
docs: On an UnderMinSealed void, the one sealer that receives the penalty-pool remainder.

types.name: SeatIndexAccount
docs: One PDA per occupied seat index, preventing duplicate seat numbers in a match.

types.name: SeatPayout
docs: Per-sealer payout indexed by engine seat (contiguous 0..sealed_count).

types.name: SettleArgs
docs: Settlement args — v1 trusts backend-computed payouts; the chain enforces conservation
and signed-price authenticity only. See `submit_settlement` TODO(v1+) for restoring
on-chain action-log replay + `verify_settlement`.

types.name: SignedPriceDto
docs: EIP-191/secp256k1 signed price payload emitted by the signed-price-server.
The signed bytes are exactly:
`token(20) || price_in_wad(32 byte uint256 BE) || timestamp_ms(32 byte uint256 BE)`.

types.name: VoidKind
docs: Why a match voided. Drives the per-seat refund computation (plan_v2 §5), so a
pull-based `refund` can pay the exact amount without scanning every seat.
